company.shortDescription: Female Invest is a edtech platform empowering women through subscription-based learning and community.
company.description: Female Invest is a subscription-based e-learning platform that educates women on personal finance and investing. It currently has members in 60+ countries driven by a goal to close the financial gender gap. Female Invest offers a range of educational resources, including online courses, webinars, workshops, and articles, to help women understand investment principles and strategies. The company operates on a subscription model, offering members exclusive content, tools, and events to enhance their financial knowledge and investment skills.
